SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION ADMINISTERS A RESPITE GRANT PROGRAM IN WHICH THERE IS AN APPLICATION PROCESS WITH SET ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA WHICH MUST BE MET TO RECEIVE GRANT FUNDING. ONCE FUNDING HAS BEEN RECEIVED ALL RECEIPENTS ARE REQUIRED TO COMPLETE REPORTS SHOWING THE UTILIZATIN OF THE FUNDS TO ENSURE THEY ARE BEING UTILIZED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE GRANT TERMS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, MANAGING DIRECTOR AND DIRECTOR OF BUSINESS OPERATIONS REVIEW THE FORM 990 AND IT IS REVIEWED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS PRIOR TO FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: TAC MAINTAINS A STRICT COI POLICY, WHICH IS REGULARLY AND CONSISTENTLY MONITORED AND ENFORCED BY MANAGEMENT. ALL DECISIONS TO RESPOND TO AN RFP OR A REQUEST FOR ENGAGEMENT ARE REVIEWED FOR CONFLICTS OF INTEREST BY THE ORGANIZATION PRIOR TO SUBMISSION OF A PROPOSAL OR ENGAGEMENT LETTER OF ANY KIND. EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT ANY REAL OR PERCEIVED CONFLICTS OF INTEREST TO MANAGMENT IMMEDIATELY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: TAC DOES NOT REQUIRE INDEPENDENT REVIEW OF SALARY DECISIONS FOR OFFICERS OR KEY EMPLOYEES. SALARY INCREASES ARE GENERALLY A PERCENTAGE THAT IS APPROVED BY THE BOARD PRIOR TO THE BEGINNING OF EACH FISCAL YEAR. HOWEVER, TAC DOES NOT REQUIRE THE BOARD APPROVAL TO AWARD MERIT INCREASES TO STAFF OVER THE COURSE OF ANY YEAR. THESE INCREASES ARE APPROVED BY THE DIRECTORS. JUSTIFICATION OF MERIT INCREASES ARE SUBSTANTIATED BY A DOCUMENT TO THE EMPLOYEE'S HR FILE. SALARY INCREASES FOR THE OFFICERS ARE SUBMITTED FOR THE BOARD'S APPROVAL AND PUT TO VOTE. IF TAC NEEDED A HIRE FOR A NEWLY CREATED POSITION (NOT A BACKFILL), WE WOULD RESEARCH COMPARABILITY DATA FOR THE POSITION. IN THIS CASE, SUBSTANTIATION OF THE COMPENSATION DELIBERATION AND DECISION WOULD BE DOCUMENTED.
